name: Aurorakin Polaris Shard
description: A star-frost shard recovered from polar cuirass plating.
specialEffects: Used in aurora armor reinforcement and cold-lit battle gear.

steps: Refine raw stock for Aurorakin Polaris Shard under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Aurorakin Refinery protocol before storage.
